scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @creator-platform/contracts && concurrently -k -n web,api -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @creator-platform/web" "npm run dev --workspace @creator-platform/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @creator-platform/contracts && npm run build --workspace @creator-platform/api && npm run build --workspace @creator-platform/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @creator-platform/contracts && npm run test --workspace @creator-platform/api && npm run test --workspace @creator-platform/web
